Resolves #19255

`WorkstationNativeTitlebarDragNL`'s two return assertions now pin #19208's contract, that a return home retires the returned item's vessel ownership. The dwell arm asserts `owned: false` in place of an unguarded `owners.commits.windowId` read, which threw on the first sample after the record was deleted. The whole-stack arm asserts `metricsOwned: false` in place of `metricsOwner: …?.windowId ?? null`, which mapped a retained `{windowId: null}` record (the #19188 state) to `null` and passed over it.

Evidence: L2 (both arms at the head, the red-first bisect, a mutation on the retirement) → L2 required (test-only). No residuals.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — two poll fields and their expectations in one spec, no engine line.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | outside-CI (NL specs are deselected in CI): `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=… npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs --workers=1 …/WorkstationNativeTitlebarDragNL.spec.mjs` at the head → 2 passed. |
| AC-2 | outside-CI, red-first: dev's spec at dev `08a84ef3be` → the dwell arm fails with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'windowId')`, 2/2 runs. Bisected: 2 passed at `4dc6f744e5^`, red from `4dc6f744e5` (#19208). |
| AC-3 | outside-CI, mutation: `NativeLifecycle#recordOwner`'s `null` branch retains `{windowId: null}` instead of deleting → 2 failed, on `"owned": true` and `"metricsOwned": true`; restored → green. Before the second commit, the whole-stack arm passed under the same mutation. |

## Deltas from ticket
The ticket named `:328`. The mutation showed the whole-stack arm's `:580` read passing over a retained record, so it is tightened the same way, and the ticket's Fix and AC-3 now say so.

## Test Evidence
- The census at dev `a9abb6c1dc` listed the dwell arm red (#17844).
- With only the read guarded (`?.windowId ?? null`), both arms pass at dev: the engine reintegrates, and the pane keeps its live instance and lands where the corner pointed.
